figurative_meaning_en: Achievement of desired goal; success in endeavor
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার দীর্ঘদিনের সংগ্রামের পর কাম ফতে হলো।
প্রকল্পটি শেষ হওয়ায় আমাদের কাম ফতে হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: After years of struggle, his goal was finally conquered.
The project completion marked the conquest of our work.
history: Originates from military terminology, referring to the conquest of forts or objectives in historical battles, common in Bengali literature and folklore.
note: The idiom draws from Persian-Arabic influences via Mughal era, symbolizing triumph.
